scope: Titles and full bodies of all 56 open AIO issues returned by gh issue list --state open --limit 200. Comments and closed issue history were not exhaustively inspected.

items.title: [bot] runoak sqlite:obo downloads still hit the retiring raw bbop-sqlite bucket (odkfull v1.6.1 bundles oaklib 0.6.23)
items.rationale: Runtime/download infrastructure; no new concept identity supplied.

items.title: Submit AIO to EBI OLS (public ols4)
items.rationale: OLS indexing request for the existing 442-class release.

items.title: Attach build artifacts (aio.owl, aio-base.owl, aio-full.owl) to GitHub releases
items.rationale: Attach existing release artifacts; no term addition.

items.title: Make ODK config update_repo-clean (currently fails at robot odk:import)
items.rationale: ODK configuration maintenance; no term addition.

items.title: Ontology has 8 top-level roots but the paper and docs describe 6 branches
items.rationale: Eight roots versus six documented branches is a scope/documentation discrepancy, not an accepted class addition.

items.title: Review specific ML algorithms present in comparison authorities but missing from AIO
items.rationale: All 36 named candidates assessed: 32 draft term proposals, two software/method deferrals, one overlap deferral, one existing MLP alias. See candidate ledger.

items.title: Consider adding security and lint CI workflows
items.rationale: Security/lint CI request; no concept identity supplied.

items.title: Add an artifact-freshness CI check
items.rationale: Artifact-freshness CI request; no concept identity supplied.

items.title: Add GitHub issue templates (bug report + term request)
items.rationale: Issue templates; not a concrete term request.

items.title: Enable branch protection on main and auto-delete merged branches
items.rationale: Repository protection settings; not a concept.

items.title: Sheet had 6 rows with missing/wrong labels or definitions (repaired; sanity check requested)
items.rationale: Reported sheet repairs for existing identifiers; confirm assertions separately before a source refresh.

items.title: Learning paradigms defined with genus 'deep neural network' (is-a task vs network)
items.rationale: Learning-task/network genus concern for existing classes, requiring semantic review.

items.title: Refine and add terms relevant to zero-shot and few-shot learning
items.rationale: General few-shot learning requested; existing GeneralizedFewshotLearning, IncremenetalFewshotLearning and PromptbasedFineTuningLLM related synonyms require scope review before a new class.

items.title: Include linkages between branches
items.rationale: Cross-branch performs-task links; no accepted new class.

items.title: Language Models are not restricted to natural language
items.rationale: LanguageModel scope beyond natural language; proposed subtypes remain suggestions, not accepted identifiers.

items.title: check w3id resolution and make sure raw GitHub URLs aren't in manuscript
items.rationale: IRI and manuscript URL maintenance.

items.title: Expand with risks from AI Risk Repository
items.rationale: AI Risk Repository: reusable risk taxonomy lead. A dated release, reuse terms, identity mapping and risk-versus-bias representation need assessment; not enumerated/imported here.

items.title: The Function hierarchy is potentially overly flat
items.rationale: LLM-suggested function groupings require primary mathematical definitions; they are not scientific evidence or accepted classes.

items.title: AIO.db accessible at semantic sql
items.rationale: Link existing semantic-sql distribution.

items.title: Build out the classes for embeddings
items.rationale: Embedding expansion and input/output modeling; GloVe is covered by the issue-167 proposal. No exhaustive embedding census.

items.title: duplicate descriptions/definitions... see reports in general!
items.rationale: Existing definition duplicates require separate review; not a new-term roster.

items.title: Add attribution/provenance fields
items.rationale: Curator/date fields; schema metadata, not concepts.

items.title: Please add synonyms to 'Retrieval-Augmented LLM'
items.rationale: AIO:RetrievalAugmentedLLM already exists. RAG wording is a related-synonym request, not authority to duplicate the class or equate all RAG systems with LLMs.

items.title: Paper Suggestions
items.rationale: ITO/Biomappings alignment lead; mappings do not establish class identity or authorize external-ID imports.

items.title: add 'frequency illusion' to Bias
items.rationale: Frequency illusion is a candidate from a Wikipedia link; obtain primary evidence and AI-relevant scope before a definition proposal.

items.title: Look for any problems with BioPortal ingestion
items.rationale: BioPortal ingestion/version behavior; no accepted new class.

items.title: Add ontology details and class visualization to docs
items.rationale: Ontology documentation and visualizations.

items.title: Add further `related synonyms` values
items.rationale: Broader related-synonym curation; related strings are not exact class matches.

items.title: Curate PyTorch and TensorFlow Layer and Function classes versus each other
items.rationale: PyTorch/TensorFlow layer equivalence must be evaluated semantically; names alone cannot decide identity.

items.title: Add column values to Layers column for LLMs
items.rationale: Layer annotations for existing LLM classes.

items.title: Add DOIs for LLM and Preprocessing branches
items.rationale: DOI annotations for existing branches.

items.title: model drift metrics
items.rationale: Drift metrics lead from a vendor blog. AIO:ConceptDriftBias already has exact synonym Concept Drift; specific metric identities still need primary definitions.

items.title: collider-stratification bias
items.rationale: Collider-stratification bias lead; inspect causal definitions and distinguish it from existing SelectionAndSamplingBias before proposing a class.

items.title: consider terms from ONNX
items.rationale: ONNX operator catalog lead. Version operators and separate computational operations from library utilities; no performance assertion adopted from issue wording.

items.title: transformer taxonomy
items.rationale: Transformer taxonomy blog is a discovery lead; resolve architecture variants against primary publications and existing classes.

items.title: data hazards
items.rationale: Data Hazards v1.0 has a paper and vocabulary lead; assess version, license and hazard/bias representation before reuse.

items.title: model terms from Google ML glossary
items.rationale: Google ML glossary is a source lead, not a pinned ontology release or blanket evidence for all terminology.

items.title: literature data integrity for MedAI
items.rationale: Medical-AI research-literature integrity survey: claim/evidence research lead, not a native concept inventory.

items.title: complete addition of PyTorch classes
items.rationale: PyTorch layer coverage request beyond pooling/normalization; version and semantically align before adoption.

items.title: import terms from Data Use Ontology
items.rationale: DUO is a separate ontology; its IDs cannot be silently converted into AIO class IDs.

items.title: chatbot/prompt branch
items.rationale: Prompting documentation lead; distinguish prompting methods from chatbot/model instances.

items.title: NIST trustworthy AI glossary
items.rationale: NIST trustworthy-AI glossary lead; select a dated authority edition and assess overlap before importing terms.

items.title: add AI security branch
items.rationale: AI security/prompting branch lead; no bounded set of accepted identifiers supplied.

items.title: more bias terms
items.rationale: Bias candidate phrases include existing ImplicitBias and overlap with SystemicBias. Unbiased states and intentional/hostile categories need distinct definitions and primary evidence.

items.title: add 'Anomaly' branch for AIO
items.rationale: Outliers, contamination and mislabeling mix observations, dataset properties and processes. Define these distinctions before an Anomaly branch.

items.title: Bioportal displays details for each class with field name 'IAO_00001115'
items.rationale: BioPortal annotation-label display; not a term addition.

items.title: add terms and relations from Reproducibility Taxonomy
items.rationale: Reproducibility taxonomy/paper lead; map leakage/error categories against the Bias branch before adoption.

items.title: import huggingface models and tasks
items.rationale: Hugging Face model inventory mixes named trained models and tasks. Model-instance IDs are not currently standalone AIConcept records.

items.title: make ontology IRI resolvable
items.rationale: Resolvable ontology IRI request; no new class.

items.title: Add import to DUO
items.rationale: DUO import proposal; same representation boundary as issue 34.

items.title: Add bias knowledge from additional sources
items.rationale: Wikipedia/Psychology Today bias lists are discovery leads, not primary support for new scientific definitions.

items.title: Add terms from papers with code's methods.json
items.rationale: Papers With Code methods.json provenance/version unresolved in the request; obtain an attributable snapshot before reuse.

items.title: add terms for categories
items.rationale: Template placeholder supplies no actual preferred term, definition or parent.

items.title: New terms request under: Activation function
items.rationale: All 13 named activation functions have corresponding accepted AIO function classes. serialize and deserialize are API serialization utilities, not activation functions; no new activation record justified.

items.title: relate layers to networks
items.rationale: Layer/network part-of relations after deduplication; not a new-term roster.

items.title: ROBOT report parent issue
items.rationale: ROBOT report and exact-synonym collisions on existing concepts require targeted review.

limitations: Source leads remain candidates for research, not accepted AIO classes or completed scientific reviews.
Issue labels and assertions are not primary scientific evidence.
